A LITTLE MORE CLARITY

Before your
next step.

A service engagement begins with your requirement.

What is YBS?+

The Y Business Services brings technology development, support operations, and specialist business services together through coordinated engagements and a connected platform.

Do you only offer consulting?+

No. Consulting is one way to define the requirement. Our service range also includes mobile apps, websites, software engineering, IT support, BPO, accounting, compliance, branding, and HR support.

Can I start with one service?+

Yes. Begin with the requirement you have today. Related work can be scoped separately as your business needs it.

How do I get started?+

Explore a service, prepare a brief, and use your YBS account to take the conversation forward. Scope and commercial terms are agreed for the engagement.
